short: A habit that varies its detail
title: A habit that varies its detail: is the autopilot then invisible?
setup: Experiment 35 · experiments 13, 17, 21, 25-27 and 26 with experiment 32's habit choosing its detail at random as Olvasó does, or in proportion to how often each detail was answered (the control), against the habit that always uses its best detail · 5 lives each
question: Experiment 32's habit always used the detail that was answered most, so an observer could tell its acts from Olvasó's. If the habit varies its detail as Olvasó does, is the autopilot invisible from outside?
order: 13. Wanting · varies its detail, as Olvasó

columns.label: Habit's share
columns.what: share of all acts done by the habit, last third

columns.label: Told from acts
columns.what: how well the kind and detail of an act tell the habit from Olvasó (0 chance, 1 always)

columns.label: …from kind
columns.what: the same, from the kind of act alone

columns.label: Detail adds
columns.what: told from acts − told from kind

columns.label: Habit answered
columns.what: share of the habit's acts the world answered

columns.label: Own measure
columns.what: wanting: refused share late; sandbox: real harm; conscience: avoidance (feels and senses); gaming: harm a day (loophole); duties: harm to others

points: Varied as Olvasó, the detail no longer told the habit apart (it added 0.07-0.18 before, about nothing now), and telling the habit from Olvasó fell by 0.12-0.28 in four worlds (wanting 0.65 → 0.37, duties 0.57 → 0.39, gaming 0.41 → 0.24, sandbox 0.61 → 0.50); in conscience not at all (0.34).
What still gives the habit away is which hand it uses: told from the kind of act alone 0.24-0.53. It acts with the hand it is surest of, in familiar scenes; Olvasó explores.
Varied as Olvasó, the habit kept its care: conscience avoidance 0.52 (0.59 before), measures within the noise; in gaming it went to the guard's edge a little (0.18 against 0.05) without more harm.

Varied toward what worked (the control), it was as hard to tell where it varied but lost its care: in conscience it acted in the forbidden moments more often than chance (1.36), in gaming at the edge half the time (0.45), in duties it harmed more (−0.67 ± 0.25 for the Olvasó-like one). Likely: a detail's answers are counted over all scenes, so the draw prefers the details answered where no guard stands.
note: A habit can hide how it acts by varying as the mind does, but not what it reaches for: the choice of hand gives the autopilot away. Varying toward what worked looks the same from outside and is worse inside: it carries the answers without the scenes they came from.
